vfx_spell_bulwark_litany.alt_text: Three interlocking bronze shield ribs rise inside a low amber oath ring.

vfx_spell_quickmarch_hymn.alt_text: Three brass pennant horns race above a bright bootstep and streaming amber cloth.

vfx_spell_bloodwake_drum.alt_text: A hide war drum stands inside a crescent surge of dark red bog water and reeds.

vfx_spell_relay_drum.alt_text: Three reed-frame signal drums relay teal and amber ripples around a triangle.

vfx_spell_lens_aurora_chorus_10.alt_text: Five glass tuning vanes fan from a faceted star and carry separate aurora ribbons.

vfx_spell_lens_mirror_facet_20.alt_text: A tilted silver mirror splits one amber ray into a blue crystalline half-shell.

vfx_spell_root_bloom_bark_20.alt_text: Six mossy bark plates bloom around green sap and small ivory flowers.

vfx_spell_root_bark_bark_08.alt_text: Overlapping dark bark strips form an empty mantle fastened by two living vine knots.

vfx_spell_stone_veil.alt_text: Five chained basalt slabs rise in an arc with narrow molten seams.

vfx_spell_pressure_clause.alt_text: Opposing brass piston jaws crush a red-hot riveted core through steam and ember shards.

vfx_spell_obituary_mark.alt_text: Four black salt-flecked ink strokes close around a cold lantern flame.

vfx_spell_fogwake_step.alt_text: Salt-wet boot impressions climb a pale crescent wake toward a hooded lantern.

vfx_spell_old_measure_tally_tally_20.alt_text: A hinged brass survey caliper snaps shut across plain notched ebony rods.

vfx_spell_old_measure_count_boundary_30.alt_text: Six survey stakes and plumb weights lock a brass chain into an irregular boundary.

vfx_spell_beacon_lantern_oath_17.alt_text: An open brass lantern releases its flame while soot-black chains split away.

vfx_spell_beacon_writ_lance_13.alt_text: A blank parchment lance punches through a narrow white-gold ring.

vfx_spell_mire_lowtide_rot_16.alt_text: A drained marsh basin cracks around rotten reeds and decay blisters.

vfx_spell_mire_leech_poultice_26.alt_text: A glowing herbal poultice draws dark droplets through three curled leech shapes.

vfx_spell_lens_array_ray_06.alt_text: Three aligned prism lenses converge into a sharp white-blue ray.

vfx_spell_lens_crown_prism_16.alt_text: Seven upright crystal shards lift black smoke into clean bright droplets.

vfx_spell_root_canopy_graft_06.alt_text: Split branches knit with golden sap beneath unfolding leaves.

vfx_spell_root_canopy_thorn_22.alt_text: A forked canopy drives a heavy thorn spear through a hooked briar ring.

vfx_spell_furnace_coal_clause_17.alt_text: Brass clamps crush a coal block into molten fractures and steam.

vfx_spell_furnace_rivet_clause_05.alt_text: Six red-hot rivets buckle a round iron plate from every side.

vfx_spell_veil_lantern_mark_16.alt_text: A hooded harbor lantern stamps a dark salt ring with a hard beam.

vfx_spell_veil_moon_mark_28.alt_text: Three black tide arcs crack a pearl disk into a crescent shockwave.

vfx_spell_old_measure_compass_correction.alt_text: A brass survey needle sweeps broken chalk beyond a clean open circle.

vfx_spell_old_measure_marker_tally_08.alt_text: Iron marker weights split a stack of blank stone tally blocks.

vfx_spell_beacon_bell_lance_25.alt_text: A split bronze bell fires an ivory sound spear through angular shock rings.

vfx_spell_mire_silt_rot_04.alt_text: A cracked silt basin collapses around black reeds and decay blisters.

vfx_spell_mire_sluice_poultice_14.alt_text: A reed poultice opens beneath clean water and amber herbs.

vfx_spell_mire_flood_rot_28.alt_text: A dark flood ring bursts through rotten reeds and fungal foam.

vfx_spell_lens_mirror_prism_04.alt_text: A silver mirror prism draws in black wisps and releases clear droplets.

vfx_spell_lens_halo_ray_18.alt_text: A narrow ray passes through a segmented brass halo and crystal lens.

vfx_spell_lens_starlens_prism_28.alt_text: A faceted starlens refracts black fragments into pearl-white beads.

vfx_spell_root_loam_thorn_10.alt_text: A root-wood thorn spear drags loam, torn roots, and stones behind it.

vfx_spell_root_graft_graft_18.alt_text: Three bark plates clamp a glowing graft union beneath fresh buds.

vfx_spell_veil_mourning_mark_04.alt_text: A blank black seal sits beneath a pearl crescent and one silver tear.

vfx_spell_old_measure_index_correction_1.alt_text: A brass survey arm aligns blank stone markers and sweeps dark chalk away.

vfx_spell_beacon_lockfire_muster.alt_text: Seven lock lanterns surge along a broken bronze bar above a crossing blue sluice current.

vfx_spell_mire_moonfen_dragnet.alt_text: Hooked reeds pull a knotted dragnet closed around a moonlit blackwater basin.

vfx_spell_lens_seven_facet_refrain.alt_text: Seven glasslike sound petals spiral from a bright central pulse while dark shards break apart.

vfx_spell_root_heartwood_renewal.alt_text: Living roots and flowering boughs close into a shelter around a rising heartwood light.

vfx_spell_furnace_redline_overdrive.alt_text: Twin brass pressure cylinders drive two horizontal furnace jets through a red-hot limit ring.

vfx_spell_veil_drowned_bell_verdict.alt_text: A drowned bell tolls inside a pale echo ring as spectral tidewater and dark stones burst outward.

vfx_spell_old_measure_unbroken_meridian.alt_text: A straight survey meridian locks an ivory globe inside crossing brass shield lines and plumb marks.

vfx_spell_bolt.alt_text: A single sleek dart of pale blue-white force flying point-first to the right, a short crackling tail of thin silver-blue light behind it, a few tiny sparks; plain and clean, the simplest of spells.

vfx_spell_mend.alt_text: Soft pale blue-white threads of light stitching together in a loose open ring around the centre, a few tiny silver motes drifting upward; gentle and plain.

vfx_spell_sharpen.alt_text: Three tall upright blade shapes of bright pale silver-blue light rising around the open centre, each edge flashing white along its length, a bold shower of whetstone sparks at their bases.

vfx_spell_quicken.alt_text: Light pale blue-white speed ribbons sweeping diagonally up and to the right around the open centre like a gust of luminous wind, a few small feathers of light.

vfx_spell_shell.alt_text: A smooth translucent pale blue-white dome of force, thin and glassy, faint hexagonal facets along its rim, the centre clear and see-through.

vfx_spell_steady.alt_text: Four upright pale silver bars of light standing in a ring around the open centre like a ghostly rank of shields, joined by one level band of blue-white light.

vfx_spell_hobble.alt_text: Heavy pale blue-white chains of force with two small weighted balls lying low around the bottom of the open centre, links glowing faintly, dragging on the ground.

vfx_spell_daze.alt_text: A slow lazy ring of small pale blue-white stars and tiny hourglass shapes circling the upper part of the open centre, a soft haze trailing between them.

vfx_spell_snare.alt_text: The jaws of a leg-hold trap made of glowing pale blue-white force closing from both sides around the bottom of the open centre, a short chain of light behind them.

vfx_spell_unweave.alt_text: Loose threads of pale blue-white light unravelling outward from around the open centre, frayed glowing strands and small silver knots coming undone.

vfx_spell_cleanse.alt_text: A clear cascade of pale blue-white water-light pouring down around the open centre, bright droplets and a soft rinse of silver foam at the bottom washing dark flecks away.

vfx_spell_shift.alt_text: A bold sweep of bright pale blue-white light sliding sideways to the right around the open centre: three solid afterimage arcs of force with glowing white leading edges and a short spray of silver sparks.

vfx_spell_overdrive.alt_text: Brass furnace valves on both sides of the open centre venting upward jets of orange fire and white steam, a red-hot glow at their mouths, small sparks; fierce and rising.

vfx_spell_stoke.alt_text: Glowing coals and small tongues of flame rising in a loose upward spiral around the open centre, a brass poker of light stirring them, embers drifting up.

vfx_spell_cooling_slag.alt_text: Heavy molten slag pooling and hardening around the bottom of the open centre, bright orange cracks in a darkening grey crust, wisps of steam rising.

vfx_spell_ember_lash.alt_text: A whip of molten ember links cracking in one wide curling arc around the open centre, its tip bursting into a small spray of orange embers, thin heat shimmer along the lash.

vfx_spell_hot_iron.alt_text: Bright orange-hot iron staples searing closed in a ring around the open centre, a curl of white steam rising from each and a few small sparks.

vfx_spell_rivet_plate.alt_text: Curved plates of dark forged iron with glowing orange-hot rivet heads assembling into an open half-shell around the centre, sparks flying where the rivets are struck.

vfx_spell_cinder_spray.alt_text: A dense bright fan of glowing orange cinders and burning sparks bursting outward around the open centre in a wide cone, many large glowing embers with small flame tongues and thin grey smoke.

vfx_spell_spark_swarm.alt_text: A dense swarm of many bright orange-yellow sparks with glowing comet tails swirling in a wide ring around the open centre, the sparks large and vivid, a warm glow between them.

vfx_spell_molten_edge.alt_text: Molten orange metal running down three upright blade edges rising around the open centre, drips of glowing iron falling and small flames licking from the edges, on a fully transparent background.

vfx_spell_cinderfall.alt_text: A heavy shower of large glowing cinders and burning coals falling from above onto the open centre in bright orange streaks, and a bold ring of flames and embers flaring up at the bottom.

vfx_spell_flashpoint.alt_text: A sudden ring-shaped blast of white-hot and orange flame tongues bursting outward around a fully transparent centre, bright sparks flying; no dark or black fill anywhere, the middle stays empty and see-through.

vfx_spell_annealing.alt_text: Bright rings of glowing orange-white heat rising around the open centre like hot steel, solid glowing bands cooling to steel-blue at their tops, heat shimmer and a few slow sparks.

vfx_spell_heavy_plating.alt_text: Thick dark iron plates bolted together with big brass bolts into a heavy open shell around the centre, an orange glow in the seams.

vfx_spell_tempering.alt_text: A burst of quench steam around a tall open shell of rippling tempered steel with a blue-violet temper sheen and glowing orange edges, the centre clear.

vfx_spell_smelters_bargain.alt_text: A small brass crucible tipping above the open centre and pouring a column of furnace fire down onto it, dark red at its root and blazing orange where it lands.

vfx_spell_goad.alt_text: A burst of hot red-orange fury flaring around the open centre in the outline of a snorting bull's head made of flame and smoke, sparks at the horn tips.

vfx_spell_molten_brand.alt_text: A glowing orange-white branding plate shaped like a hammer-and-anvil seal pressing down over the open centre, molten drips and sizzling smoke.

vfx_spell_kiln_burst.alt_text: A brick kiln mouth bursting open in a wide dome of orange fire with hot bricks flying outward around the open centre, thick embers and dark smoke at the edges.

vfx_spell_crucible_ward.alt_text: Molten brass rising out of a small floating iron crucible below the centre and spreading upward into a tall open half-shell of glowing liquid metal, edges dripping gold, the protected centre left clear.

vfx_spell_full_steam.alt_text: Great plumes of white steam and orange fire rising from a ring of brass pipes and pistons around the open centre, sparks and a deep red glow.

vfx_spell_molten_deluge.alt_text: A heavy downpour of large glowing molten iron drops and streams falling onto the open centre from above, bright orange-white splashes and small pools of molten metal spattering at the bottom.

vfx_spell_iron_oath.alt_text: Tall riveted iron plates glowing at the seams closing into an open shield-wall around the centre, an anvil seal stamped in orange light on its rim.

vfx_spell_second_sun.alt_text: A small blazing orange-white second sun with a flaring corona hanging above the open centre, its scorching rays slanting down, heat shimmer below.

vfx_spell_redline.alt_text: A brass pressure gauge above the open centre with its needle swinging into a glowing red zone, jets of red-orange fire and steam bursting upward around it.

vfx_spell_foundry_golem.alt_text: A tipping foundry ladle above the centre pouring a stream of molten brass that splashes and hisses into a glowing pool, sparks flying outward.

vfx_spell_clockwork_twin.alt_text: Brass gears, springs and cogwheels whirling and assembling in an open ring around the centre, golden sparks and thin clockwork light lines.

vfx_spell_brass_sentinel.alt_text: Flying brass plates, rivets and gears assembling around the open centre with glowing orange seams and sparks, a sense of something being built.

vfx_spell_heartwood_stance.alt_text: Thick roots plunging into the ground around the bottom of the open centre while golden-amber heartwood light rises up through them, leaves stirring.

vfx_spell_grasping_roots.alt_text: Gnarled living roots with thorns rising from below and coiling inward in a tightening open spiral around the empty centre, flecks of dark soil and a few green leaves, amber sap glinting at the knots.

vfx_spell_pollen_drift.alt_text: A soft drifting cloud of glowing golden pollen and small yellow blossoms curling inward around the open centre, sleepy and slow, a few tiny crescent-moon motes.

vfx_spell_thornshot.alt_text: A tight volley of sharp green-brown thorns flying point-first to the right, a few green leaves and amber sap droplets trailing behind.

vfx_spell_green_mending.alt_text: Green vines with small new leaves knitting together in a loose open ring around the centre, soft green-gold healing light and tiny buds opening.

vfx_spell_thornmail.alt_text: A wrapping shell of thorny brambles and dark green leaves woven into an open coat around the centre, sharp thorns pointing outward, amber sap glints.

vfx_spell_graft.alt_text: Two strands of living bark and green shoots braiding together around the open centre, small leaves and golden sap seams binding them.

vfx_spell_budding.alt_text: Many small green buds and new shoots sprouting and swelling into leafy pods in a ring around the open centre, warm golden sap glow.

vfx_spell_earthsplit.alt_text: The ground bursting open in a bold jagged crack beneath the open centre, big chunks of earth and stone flung upward and outward with a spray of dust and torn roots.

vfx_spell_bloomburst.alt_text: A burst of pink-white blossoms and green leaves opening outward around the open centre, petals drifting, soft golden pollen light.

vfx_spell_seed_of_return.alt_text: A large glowing golden seed below the open centre sprouting a bold green vine that spirals up around it, unfurling bright leaves in a soft golden glow.

vfx_spell_bark_ring.alt_text: A ring of rough brown bark plates rising and closing into an open shell around the centre, moss and small leaves on its rim, amber sap in the seams.

vfx_spell_blight.alt_text: Withered black-brown leaves and rotting vines curling around the open centre, sickly yellow-green spores and drops of dark sap, decay creeping inward.

vfx_spell_uproot.alt_text: Roots tearing up out of the ground and coiling around the open centre, wrenching it sideways to the right, clods of earth and torn grass flying.

vfx_spell_wake_the_grove.alt_text: Gnarled tree trunks rising out of the ground with leafy crowns unfurling around the open centre, soil and roots spraying, green-gold light.

vfx_spell_spore_cloud.alt_text: A heavy sickly cloud of yellow-green spores billowing and curling inward around the open centre, small mushroom caps puffing at the bottom.

vfx_spell_sapflood.alt_text: Ribbons of luminous amber sap flowing upward around the open centre like a gentle rising flood, new green shoots and small leaves unfurling along them, soft golden droplets.

vfx_spell_ironbark.alt_text: A tall open shell of dark grey bark as hard as iron with a metallic sheen and growth rings, small glancing sparks bouncing off its rim.

vfx_spell_grasp_of_the_deep.alt_text: Enormous dark roots rising from deep below and crushing inward around the open centre, heaving cracked earth, glowing amber veins running through the roots.

vfx_spell_spring_eternal.alt_text: A fountain of green-gold spring light rising around the open centre, leaves, buds and blossoms spiralling upward and regrowing as they rise.

vfx_spell_green_return.alt_text: A great spiral of new green leaves and glowing seeds rising from the ground around the open centre, small sprouts bursting into growth.

vfx_spell_waking_forest.alt_text: An elder treant's great antlered crown of branches and leaves rising from the ground behind the open centre, young trees springing up around it, soil spraying.

vfx_spell_call_to_arms.alt_text: A bright white-gold signal flare rocketing upward and forward to the right across the open centre, a bold burst of golden sparks at its head and a thin glowing golden trail behind it, no smoke cloud and no haze.

vfx_spell_sighting_mark.alt_text: A bright white-gold target ring with four crosshair spikes of light floating over the open centre, a small lantern glint at its top.

vfx_spell_dazzle.alt_text: A blinding white-gold flash flaring outward in sharp star rays around the open centre, dazzled spots of light swirling inward.

vfx_spell_radiant_mend.alt_text: Clean white-gold light pouring down in soft beams around the open centre, dark smoky wisps burning away at the edges, small sparkles.

vfx_spell_prism_ward.alt_text: A tall open prism of clear crystal facets around the centre, refracting a small rainbow of light, white-gold edges glinting.

vfx_spell_dawn_lance.alt_text: A long straight lance of white-gold dawn light flying to the right, a bright sunrise flare at its tail and a sharp glowing point, thin warm rays streaming off its length.

vfx_spell_morning_light.alt_text: Warm morning sunlight falling in soft golden rays around the open centre, motes of light and a faint warm halo; gentle.

vfx_spell_signal_swap.alt_text: Two curving arcs of white-gold signal light crossing each other in an X around the open centre, small flashes at each end as they trade places.

vfx_spell_volley_signal.alt_text: A bright white-gold flare bursting above the open centre in a ring of golden light, and many bold glowing arrows of light raining down toward the centre from above.

vfx_spell_prism_bolt.alt_text: A bolt of split light flying to the right, a white core at its head splitting into thin rainbow-tinted beams along its tail, a small crystal glint at the point.

vfx_spell_rekindle.alt_text: A ring of bold white-gold flames kindling around the open centre, rising like lantern flames with bright sparks lifting upward and a warm glow at their base.

vfx_spell_watchful_light.alt_text: A large glowing brass lantern of white-gold light hovering above the open centre, casting a broad bold cone of warm light down over it with golden motes in the beam.

vfx_spell_glass_aegis.alt_text: A smooth clear glass dome closing over the open centre, bright white-gold reflections along its curve, a few spell sparks glancing off.

vfx_spell_steadfast_halo.alt_text: A steady wide halo ring of white-gold light hovering above the open centre, soft pillars of light falling from it to the ground.

vfx_spell_hour_ledger.alt_text: An open ledger of white-gold light with its pages flipping backward behind the open centre, a clock face of light turning counter-clockwise.

vfx_spell_censure.alt_text: A judgement seal of white-gold light descending onto the open centre, a shining padlock and small balance scales in its rim, rays pressing down.

vfx_spell_searing_ray.alt_text: A narrow searing beam of white-hot light flying to the right, its edges burning gold-orange, a bright lens flare at its head.

vfx_spell_sanctuary.alt_text: A ring of tall white-gold light columns around the open centre joined by a soft dome of light, quiet and still, a few slow motes.

vfx_spell_lantern_vigil.alt_text: A ring of six bright hanging lanterns of warm white-gold light floating around the open centre, each glowing strongly with light pooling below it.

vfx_spell_clarion_call.alt_text: A brass clarion of light sounding waves of white-gold rings that sweep forward to the right around the open centre.

vfx_spell_echo.alt_text: Concentric rings of white-gold light echoing outward like the sound of a struck bell, a faint bell outline above the open centre.

vfx_spell_daybreak_charge.alt_text: A rising sunburst of dawn light behind the open centre with streaming golden rays and pennant-shaped light trails sweeping forward and upward.

vfx_spell_dawn_of_return.alt_text: A great dawn breaking behind the open centre, golden-white sun rays fanning upward and motes of light rising from the ground like returning sparks.

vfx_spell_eternal_noon.alt_text: A blazing white-gold noon sun standing directly above the open centre, a perfect circle with straight vertical rays falling, still and unmoving.

vfx_spell_hungering.alt_text: Dark violet tendrils of hungry shadow rising around the open centre, small crimson motes drawn inward along them, silver mist.

vfx_spell_dread.alt_text: Whispering wisps of violet-black mist with faint pale ghostly faces curling inward around the open centre, cold silver glints.

vfx_spell_fog_mind.alt_text: Grey-violet fog swirling in confused eddies and spirals around the upper open centre, a faint helmet-shaped outline of mist inside it.

vfx_spell_wasting_curse.alt_text: A sickly violet curse sigil of smoke circling the open centre, a small smoking skull shape at its top, dark motes drifting away.

vfx_spell_mist_cloak.alt_text: A hooded cloak of soft silver-violet mist wrapping around the open centre, its edges fading into nothing, faint moonlight glints.

vfx_spell_leech.alt_text: Bold streams of dark crimson and violet life-light pulled out of the open centre and spiralling upward in thick glowing ribbons, bright blood-red motes along them.

vfx_spell_blood_tithe.alt_text: A stream of dark red light flowing in a curving arc around the open centre into a small silver chalice of mist, crimson motes.

vfx_spell_changeling_swap.alt_text: Two curling folds of violet mist twisting into each other around the open centre like a turning hourglass, silver moon glints.

vfx_spell_hollowing.alt_text: A hollow ring of black-violet void opening around the open centre, pulling dark wisps and crimson motes inward from every side.

vfx_spell_tolling_doom.alt_text: A dark iron bell of violet shadow hanging above the open centre, rings of sound rippling down from it, cold silver glints.

vfx_spell_last_breath.alt_text: A thin silver thread of spirit light and a pale breath of mist circling the open centre and holding it, a soft violet glow at the edges.

vfx_spell_fogwalk.alt_text: Wisps of silver-violet fog streaming forward to the right around the open centre and dissolving into faint trails.

vfx_spell_night_terror.alt_text: A looming hooded shadow of violet-black mist rising behind the open centre, two pale cold eyes and a gaping dark mouth, wisps of silver mist reaching forward like claws.

vfx_spell_raise_the_fallen.alt_text: Pale silver-violet spirits rising out of the ground in a column of mist around the centre, a torn banner of mist drifting above them.

vfx_spell_decoy.alt_text: A shimmering violet mist copy peeling away from the open centre to one side, a mirror glint of silver light between them.

vfx_spell_puppet_strings.alt_text: A dark crossbar of violet shadow above the open centre with bold glowing violet puppet strings hanging down and pulled taut around it, bright violet sparks where they grip.

vfx_spell_grave_edge.alt_text: Three pale grave-cold blades of silver-blue spectral light rising around the open centre, frosty violet mist trailing from their edges.

vfx_spell_stupor.alt_text: A heavy drooping cloud of deep violet sleep-mist sinking down over the open centre, slow swirls and small dim stars.

vfx_spell_deaths_door.alt_text: A dark iron door-knocker ring of violet shadow hanging over the open centre, three cold silver knock-flashes rippling outward from it.

vfx_spell_fever_wind.alt_text: A sickly green-violet wind gusting across the open centre in curling streaks, fever fumes and small dark motes swirling with it.

vfx_spell_shadow_ranks.alt_text: Rows of faint shadowy spear tips and helmets of violet mist rising behind the open centre, their edges lit by silver moonlight.

vfx_spell_long_night.alt_text: A deep night of violet-black mist with a thin crescent moon and a few cold stars sinking over the open centre, heavy and quiet.

vfx_spell_black_tide.alt_text: A dark black-violet wave of water crashing over the open centre, foam edged in cold silver, drowned glints.

vfx_spell_wraith_host.alt_text: Two pale wraiths of silver-violet mist swooping down in curving trails onto the centre, tattered ghostly shapes in cold moonlight.

vfx_spell_drowned_host.alt_text: Rusted helmets and spear tips rising out of black water around the centre, violet mist on the surface, cold silver glints.

vfx_spell_hollow_crown.alt_text: A hollow crown of dark iron and violet shadow floating above the open centre, ghostly wisps rising up through it, silver glints.
